items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: There's a friend of mine here in Los Angeles by the name of Paul Howard.

ctx.x: And I believe that and I still believe it, and no matter what happens it seems to be evident I think that the right way is usually the best way. There's a friend of mine here in Los Angeles by the name of Paul Howard. He was the secretary of the black musician's union, the old one, 767, which I was a member when I came to California years ago, and I went over to the integrated union, local 47. But he used to have a saying, that I never forgot. He said, if you never lie you never have to remember anything.
